newsitem.title: FRANCE: EP broadly endorses IGC text.
newsitem.headline: EP broadly endorses IGC text.

text.p: The European Parliament broadly endorsed on Thursday a draft text submitted by Ireland for the inter-governmental conference on the EU's future.

The parliament, commenting for the first time on the text submitted in December, said it was in favour of the new idea of flexibility, which would allow member states which want to forge ahead with closer cooperation in certain areas to be able to do so even if others held back.

But it said there were limits, and flexibility should be the exception rather than the rule, should be a transitional arrangement and be accompanied by support measures for those not taking part to make it possible for them to join in a reasonable time.
The parliament also called for a uniform electoral procedure to replace the mix of systems currently used in the different member states to elect deputies to the EU assembly.

It also calls for the EU to take a greater role in fighting international crime and drug trafficking and for a beefed up social policy protocol in the new EU treaty, which the Dutch presidency hopes to finalise in Amsterdam in June.
